result.reason: The workflow sends the user's email and one-time sign-in code to an external authentication endpoint without requiring explicit prior consent to transmit the credential.
The move sends password changes to the service's metadata endpoint without requiring explicit prior consent for that secret transmission.
The authenticated and anonymous-update branches transmit API keys or claim tokens externally without requiring explicit prior consent.
The request transmits an account bearer API key externally without requiring explicit prior consent; the evidence does not establish server-side content copying.
The helper transmits a Drive token or account API key to external Drive API endpoints without requiring explicit prior consent.
